title: Token Classification
description: Classifies text tokens - keywords, strings, types, comments - so each gets its semantic color. Classification is the brain of syntax highlighting: the colors mean something because the classifier understood the code.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Palette Generation
description: Generates harmonious palettes from a seed color using color-theory rules - analogous, triadic, tonal. Generated palettes give non-designers professional color without guesswork.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Contrast Checking
description: Computes WCAG contrast ratios between text and background, enforcing 4.5:1 for body text. Checking is non-negotiable: low contrast locks out millions of readers.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Colorblind-Safe Palettes
description: Designs palettes distinguishable under all common color-vision deficiencies, verified by simulation. Safe palettes ensure charts and statuses communicate to everyone, not just the color-typical.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Semantic Mapping
description: Maps data semantics to color - red for danger, green for healthy, amber for warning - consistently across the whole product. Consistent mapping builds instant readability: users learn the language once.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Theme Variables
description: Defines colors as named design tokens - --color-danger, --surface-1 - so themes swap by redefining variables. Tokenized color makes dark mode and rebranding a data change, not a code hunt.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dynamic Recoloring
description: Recolors interfaces at runtime - dark mode toggles, high-contrast modes, brand switches - without reloads. Dynamic recoloring respects user needs instantly, including OS-level appearance changes.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Heatmap Scales
description: Maps numeric ranges to perceptually uniform color scales so heatmaps read truthfully. Good scales - viridis, cividis - keep equal data steps looking equal, unlike rainbow scales that lie.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Categorical Colors
description: Assigns distinct hues to categories - up to about eight - keeping them separable for typical and colorblind viewers. Categorical assignment is stable: the same category always gets the same color.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: WCAG Checks
description: Runs the full WCAG color checks - contrast, non-color indicators, focus visibility - as automated tests. Automated checks catch regressions the eye misses, especially in large design systems.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dark-Mode Mapping
description: Maps every light-theme color to its dark counterpart with preserved meaning and contrast, not naive inversion. Thoughtful mapping keeps dark mode genuinely usable instead of merely dark.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Highlight Rules
description: Defines which content gets highlighted - search hits, errors, selections - with a priority order when rules overlap. Clear highlight precedence keeps the interface scannable instead of a rainbow of competing emphasis.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Legend Generation
description: Generates legends automatically from the actual encodings used in a chart, so the legend can never disagree with the data. Auto-legends end the classic bug of a stale hand-written legend.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Color Interpolation
description: Blends between colors in perceptual space (OKLCH) so gradients transition evenly without muddy middles. Perceptual interpolation is the difference between professional gradients and amateur ones.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Accessibility Audits
description: Audits the whole product's color use - contrast, color-only meaning, focus indicators - on a schedule, tracking the score over time. Audits turn accessibility from a launch checklist into a maintained property.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
